content: Customer Reyansh Tiwari called to cancel the auto insurance policy renewal (AU-45789) as he decided to go with a different insurer. Agent Karan Joshi confirmed the policy will lapse and agreed to update the system for cancellation. The agent also agreed to email a final policy summary PDF and cancellation notice, and explained the reinstatement process requiring a fresh application if needed in the future.

action_items: Update system to reflect policy cancellation
Email policy-summary PDF and cancellation notice to the customer
